import pandas as pd

# Read the input data
input_file = "outputs/t11_city_indicator_matrix.csv"
df = pd.read_csv(input_file)

# Separate city_id, city_name, year from the rest (indicators)
# Assuming the first three columns are city_id, city_name, year
# and the remaining columns are indicators
city_cols = ['city_id', 'city_name', 'year']
indicator_cols = [col for col in df.columns if col not in city_cols]

# Calculate missing counts and rates for each indicator
indicator_stats = []
for col in indicator_cols:
    missing_count = df[col].isna().sum()
    total_count = len(df)
    missing_rate = missing_count / total_count
    indicator_stats.append({
        'indicator': col,
        'missing_count': int(missing_count),
        'missing_rate': missing_rate,
        'kept': 1 if missing_rate <= 0.30 else 0
    })

# Create the missingness report
missingness_report = pd.DataFrame(indicator_stats)
missingness_report.to_csv("outputs/t12_missingness_report.csv", index=False)

# Select only the indicators with missing_rate <= 0.30
selected_df = df.copy()
selected_df = selected_df[city_cols + [col for col in indicator_cols if missingness_report[missingness_report['indicator'] == col]['kept'].values[0] == 1]]

# Reorder columns: city_id, city_name, year, then selected indicators
selected_df = selected_df[[city_cols + [col for col in indicator_cols if missingness_report[missingness_report['indicator'] == col]['kept'].values[0] == 1]]]

selected_df.to_csv("outputs/t12_selected_matrix.csv", index=False)

print("Processing complete.")
print(f"Missingness report saved to outputs/t12_missingness_report.csv")
print(f"Selected matrix saved to outputs/t12_selected_matrix.csv")
</solution_file>
